/bin/zsh -c "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import csv
import re
import subprocess
from collections import defaultdict

pdf = Path('laundry-meeting-packet.pdf')
data = pdf.read_bytes()
data, count = re.subn(rb'/Producer ["'^'"\\r\\n]*', lambda match: b' ' * len(match[0]), data)
assert count == 1
pdf.write_bytes(data)
info = subprocess.check_output(['pdfinfo', str(pdf)], text=True)
assert re.search(r'Pages:\\s+2\\b', info)
assert not re.search(r'"'^(Author|Creator|Producer):'"', info, re.M)
body = subprocess.check_output(['pdftotext', '-layout', str(pdf), '-'], text=True)
groups = defaultdict(list)
with open('laundry-sample.csv', newline='') as source:
    for name, week, arrivals, waits in list(csv.reader(source))[1:]:
        groups[name].append((int(week), int(arrivals), int(waits)))
expected = {
    'Monday evening': [(9,3), (10,4), (8,2), (11,5)],
    'Wednesday evening': [(6,1), (7,1), (8,2), (7,1)],
    'Sunday morning': [(11,4), (12,6), (10,4), (13,7)]
}
assert set(groups) == set(expected)
for name, entries in groups.items():
    assert [week for week, _, _ in entries] == [1, 2, 3, 4]
    assert [(arrivals, waits) for _, arrivals, waits in entries] == expected[name]
    arrivals = sum(row[1] for row in entries)
    waits = sum(row[2] for row in entries)
    values = f'{arrivals} / {arrivals/4:g}', f'{waits} / {waits/4:g}', f'{100*waits/arrivals:.1f}%'
    row = next(line for line in body.splitlines() if line.strip().startswith(name))
    assert all(value in row for value in values), (row, values)
print('Verified 12 source observations, all PDF summary figures, page count, and metadata.')
PY
